title: mime-tree: test suite
description: Correctness must be verified against independent oracles, not against this crate's own output. Write tests in tests/ and src/: unit tests for parse() with hand-crafted RFC 5322 messages; RFC 8621 §4.1.4 body structure tests using hand-crafted multipart fixtures with known expected structure; decode_body_value() tests cross-validated against Python email.parser. Include at least one real-world message fixture. No test may use this crate as its own oracle.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p mime-tree passes; all oracles are external (Python email.parser, hand-crafted expected values)
